Set up unYOLO on this computer

Choose what to install, review the plan, and apply it with explicit approval.

Usage:
  unyolo setup [flags]

Options:
  -h, --help     show help
  --accessible   use screen-reader-friendly prompts
  --new          start a new setup session
  --no-open      print browser URLs instead of opening them
  --plan-only    prepare configuration without administrator changes
  --profile DIR  review or repair an advanced locked configuration at DIR
  --resume ID    resume setup session ID

Examples:
  unyolo setup
  unyolo setup --accessible
  unyolo setup --new
